p=json.load(open('policy.json')); reqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))

 ({'from':'unknown','to':'ready'}, {'edges':{},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),

 before_r=copy.deepcopy(request); before_p=copy.deepcopy(policy)
